title: Azure Functions Templates Manifest
description: Schema for the templates-manifest.json file containing Azure Functions template definitions

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the manifest was generated

version.description: Semantic version of the manifest format

totalTemplates.description: Total number of templates in the manifest

references.description: Reference URLs for documentation and sources

operations.description: Complete inventory of connector trigger operations in the pinned project. IDs, function names and owned paths must be unique; paths must not overlap. Run eng/scripts/validate-manifest.ps1 for semantic validation.

operationId.description: Exact canonical operation ID returned by the live Connector API. Do not normalize, infer or remove version suffixes.

functionName.description: Exact Azure Functions registration name in the pinned project, not a source filename or display name.

ownedPaths.description: Project-root-relative whole files/directories owned exclusively by this operation, including its deployment/config artifacts. Never include shared project files.

connectorOwnedPath.description: Safe relative POSIX path without absolute prefixes, backslashes, traversal, empty/dot segments, glob characters, control characters or trailing dots/spaces.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template (lowercase with slashes or hyphens)

shortDescription.description: Brief description of the template (max 200 characters)

longDescription.description: Detailed description of the template and its use cases

resource.description: Azure resource type the template interacts with

iac.description: Infrastructure as Code type included with the template

priority.description: Priority for sorting. 5-slot blocks per Azure resource (+0 trigger, +1 input, +2 output, +3 variant). 10-slot block for MCP (+0 remote, +1 sdk, +2 tool, +3 resource, +4 prompt, +5 apim). See docs/priority-tiers.md.

tags.description: Tags for search and discovery (Title Case)

author.description: Author or team that created the template

repositoryUrl.description: GitHub repository URL containing the template

folderPath.description: Path to template folder within the repository ('.' for root)

gitRef.description: Git ref to clone: a verified signed tag (refs/tags/v*), a branch (refs/heads/branch), or an immutable 40-hex commit SHA. Connector ownership metadata must match the pinned commit. Lightweight and unsigned tags are not accepted. Defaults to main reference.

whatsIncluded.description: List of files and components included in the template

connectorTrigger.description: Optional operation ownership contract for connector trigger projects. Consumers delete only nonselected operations' owned paths and preserve all shared files, leaving exactly the selected function and its Poll-ready deployment artifacts.

isHighlighted.description: Whether the template should be highlighted/featured in the UI
